scope: Documentation mapping/catalogue and offline viewer only; no runtime capability, release, installation or existing maturity change.

unitTests.scope: 15 generator CLI tests on disposable repositories and 13 isolated viewer tests

integratedBrowser.note: Run against the integrated and source-snapshot-refreshed atlas; the report itself is authoritative. Its output is intentionally not fingerprinted here to avoid a circular source-snapshot dependency.

preservation.note: Existing score cells, bindings, implementation records, evidence records and legacy network fingerprints are preserved. Catalogue corrections and appended records are reviewed separately.

limitations: Historical product, Godot, Bevy, installed Tauri and Android evidence was not rerun in this documentation increment.
Planned composition creation and Bevy author Rust entries do not imply implementation or validation.
A valid graph proves references and generated files are consistent, not that every feature or workflow has been accepted.
